TC-14/S07.title: Tap Generate, then reload: on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows (dev, real backend and note model)
TC-14/S07.detail: Dataset gen-ac15 on dev (live Haiku). Cell B (Hospital) and B' (Nursing Home): the dictation was typed and autosaved, Generate Note & Finish pressed, the ai/notes:generateNote request seen leaving the page, then the page reloaded. 45 s later, both modes: no note stored (Hospital status 'seen'), Post-Round shows only 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' (Hospital also the spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button); the dictation is kept (passed). The diagnostics rows show the note model DID answer on the server meanwhile (notes.generateNote, Haiku 4.5, ok, 7.8 s Hospital / 2.8 s Nursing Home): the note was generated and thrown away because the page that would have saved it was gone. Judged 4/6 (the two AC 15 cells fail). Same result as the local run (cells B/D): TFA-92592 AC 15 is not met on 43c38a4f. Rows: 2 added with the prefix, removed by the dataset cleanup (0 left, 0 other rows changed).
TC-14/S07.productIssue: On dev, Generate followed by a reload (or the app being closed) loses the note although the model wrote it: Post-Round says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.'; the physician has to tap Generate again.
